resources.string: My name is Reham. I am 21 years old, and I am passionate about creativity, technology, and digital design.
I study Web and Mobile Multimedia at Al-Aqsa University, where I develop my creative and technical knowledge.
I have various design skills, including visual creativity, color coordination, layout design, and creating attractive digital content.
My goal is to become a professional multimedia designer and create innovative websites and mobile experiences.
